title: Household Consumables Reorder Forecast
dataSources: Consumable levels (`supply:level`), parcels (`delivery:parcel`), bin collections (`bincollection:event`), gift-card balances (`giftcard:balance`).
app: Household logistics feeds — smart-scale consumable trackers, parcel/delivery tracking APIs, council bin-collection calendars, and gift-card balance logs — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=supply:level
| stats latest(level_pct) as level, avg(daily_use_pct) as usage by item
| eval days_left=round(level/usage,1)
| where days_left<10
| sort days_left
description: Estimates how many days of everyday consumables (detergent, coffee, pet food) remain and flags what to reorder.
value: A usage-based runway ends the run-out-and-dash routine for the boring but essential household staples.
implementation: Ingest smart-scale or manual consumable levels into `index=personal`; flag items running low.
visualization: Table of consumables by days of supply left.
grandmaExplanation: It works out how many days of everyday supplies like detergent are left, so you reorder before running out.
